assessment: This paper presents a valuable new method combining holographic microscopy and deep learning to track the behavior and growth of individual plankton. The paper illustrates the method with compelling data from two applications, zooplankton feeding behavior and diatom cell division. This paper will be of interest to plankton ecologists and ocean ecosystem modelers. The results obtained from this method will provide new insights into the trophic strategies of ocean plankton and important constraints for global ocean models.
